_readme: Single source of truth for UI copy in both front ends (TUI and GUI).
The active locale comes from config.language ('en' | 'zh'), read over RPC.
slash: per command id. 'en' is optional -- when absent the client falls
back to the name/help written in code, which stays the English source.
ui: both locales are required; these surfaces have no in-code source.
GUI inlines this file at build time (ui-gui/build.py).

gui.plug.prog_auth_soon.zh: 正在联系服务器，稍后会打开浏览器完成授权…
gui.plug.prog_auth_soon.en: Contacting the server - your browser will open to authorize shortly...

gui.plug.prog_ok.zh: 已连接，{n} 个工具可用，安装完成。

gui.plug.stdio_trust.zh: 仅安装你信任的发布者。

gui.plug.stdio_warn.en: This plugin will run the following command on your machine:

gui.plug.uninstall_note.en: Uninstalling removes the plugin and its connection config; to pause it, use the toggle in the list instead.

gui.plug.use_prompt.zh: 请使用「{name}」插件提供的工具来帮我完成一件事：
gui.plug.use_prompt.en: Use the tools from the "{name}" plugin to help me:

gui.plug.wait_auth.en: {name} is waiting for authorization - the install completes once you authenticate

gui.queue_note.en: Running - these go out one after another when this turn ends
gui.queue_note.zh: 运行中 · 这些会在本轮结束后依次发出

gui.reach.auth_hint.en: Acts as you in a signed-in service
gui.reach.auth_hint.zh: 以你的身份在已登录的服务里动作

gui.reach.local_hint.zh: 只碰这台电脑上的东西

gui.sess.delete_body.en: "{title}" will be deleted from disk. There is no undo.

gui.set.budget_hint.en: Token ceiling reserved for reasoning. 0 reserves none.
gui.set.budget_hint.zh: 留给推理的 token 上限。0 表示不单独留。

gui.set.cache_hint.en: Fetched pages and cached model responses.
gui.set.cache_hint.zh: 抓取的网页与模型响应缓存。

gui.set.chn.cron_ph.zh: 如 telegram, feishu；* 表示全部

gui.set.chn.entry_w.en: Add or remove a channel in its own module.
gui.set.chn.entry_w.zh: 增删渠道在自己的模块里。

gui.set.codefont_hint.en: Prose uses the system sans; code and data use a mono face.
gui.set.codefont_hint.zh: 正文用系统无衬线，代码与数据用等宽。

gui.set.confirm_risky_hint.en: Stop and confirm before deleting files, rewriting git history, or running an unfamiliar script.
gui.set.confirm_risky_hint.zh: 删文件、改 git 历史、跑陌生脚本之前停下来确认。

gui.set.cron_hint.en: Let some tasks run on their own clock; each run produces a session.
gui.set.cron_hint.zh: 让某些任务按时自己跑，每次运行产出一个会话。

gui.set.cwd_hint.en: Raven reads and writes files only inside this directory.
gui.set.cwd_hint.zh: Raven 只在这个目录里读写文件。

gui.set.dat.del_partial.zh: 已删除 {n} 个，{left} 个删不掉

gui.set.delete_all_body.en: This deletes all {n} sessions, their attachments and every stored key. It cannot be undone.
gui.set.delete_all_body.zh: 会删掉全部 {n} 个会话、附件和已存的密钥。此操作不可撤销。

gui.set.diag_hint.en: Bundles version, config and recent errors so you can file an issue.
gui.set.diag_hint.zh: 打包版本、配置和最近报错，方便提 issue。

gui.set.language_hint.en: Applies to this app, the terminal UI, and the language Raven replies in.
gui.set.language_hint.zh: 同时作用于这个 App、终端界面，以及 Raven 回复所用的语言。

gui.set.logs_hint.en: Start here when something goes wrong.

gui.set.look.fs_note.en: Text size needs the type scale reworked first
gui.set.look.fs_note.zh: 字号要等界面尺寸体系重构，暂时改不动

gui.set.mdl.providers_w.en: At least one has to be connected before a session can start.
gui.set.mdl.providers_w.zh: 至少连上一个才能开始会话。

gui.set.mdl.tuning_w.en: How hard the model thinks, and how much room it gets.
gui.set.mdl.tuning_w.zh: 模型想多久，以及给它多少余量。

gui.set.mem.models_w.en: Long-term memory runs on EverOS. It uses one model per role to extract, embed and rerank memories - configure them here.
gui.set.mem.models_w.zh: 长期记忆由 EverOS 承载。它抽取、嵌入、重排记忆各用一个模型，在这里配置。

gui.set.mem.saved.en: Saved. Takes effect after raven serve restarts.
gui.set.mem.saved.zh: 已保存，重启 raven serve 后生效。

gui.set.memory_everos_w.en: Kept by the EverOS service, shared across your clients.
gui.set.memory_everos_w.zh: 存在 EverOS 服务里，多端共享。

gui.set.memory_hint.en: Remember your preferences and project context across sessions. Off means every new session starts from zero.
gui.set.memory_hint.zh: 跨会话记住你的偏好和项目背景。关掉后每个新会话都从零开始。

gui.set.memory_local_w.en: Kept on this machine. Nothing leaves it.
gui.set.memory_local_w.zh: 存在这台机器上，不出网。

gui.set.more.en: Everything else lives in config.yaml - copy the path
gui.set.more.zh: 其余选项都在 config.yaml 里 · 复制路径

gui.set.motion_hint.en: Turns off every transition and animation except the streaming cursor.
gui.set.motion_hint.zh: 关掉流式光标之外的所有过渡与动画。

gui.set.motion_w.en: Turns off the fades and slides across the whole window.
gui.set.motion_w.zh: 关掉之后整个窗口不再有淡入和滑动。

gui.set.not_live.en: RPC not ready yet - the change was not saved
gui.set.not_live.zh: RPC 暂未就绪，改动没有保存

gui.set.ntf.denied.zh: 浏览器拒绝了通知权限，请在系统或浏览器设置里允许后再开启。
gui.set.ntf.denied.en: Notification permission was denied - allow it in your system or browser settings first.

gui.set.ntf.hero_w.en: Turned on, Raven would reach you at these moments:
gui.set.ntf.hero_w.zh: 打开后，Raven 会在这些时刻找你：

gui.set.ntf.test_body.zh: 通知长这样。任务完成而窗口不在前台时，Raven 会这样提醒你。
gui.set.ntf.test_body.en: This is what it looks like. Raven notifies you like this when a task finishes in the background.

gui.set.ntf.when.zh: 仅在窗口不在前台时提醒，任务完成即触发。
gui.set.ntf.when.en: Fires when a task finishes while the window is in the background.

gui.set.nw_note.en: Not wired to the backend yet, so changes here are not saved.
gui.set.nw_note.zh: 还没接后端，这里的改动不会保存。

gui.set.prm.ask_w.en: Every action with a side effect stops and asks you first.
gui.set.prm.ask_w.zh: 每个有副作用的动作都先停下来问你。

gui.set.prm.auto_w.en: Reads, writes and commands run straight through; only the risky ones ask.
gui.set.prm.auto_w.zh: 读写和命令直接执行，只有高风险动作才问。

gui.set.prm.composer_note.zh: 每个会话的访问权限在输入框旁选择（完全访问 / 受限）；这一页只管全局护栏。
gui.set.prm.composer_note.en: Per-session access is chosen next to the composer (full access / restricted); this page owns only the standing guard rails.

gui.set.prm.mode_note.en: The mode next to the composer is the one in effect; this one is not wired yet.
gui.set.prm.mode_note.zh: 当前生效的是输入框旁边那个模式；这里还没接后端。

gui.set.prm.ro_w.en: Reading only. No file is written and no command runs.
gui.set.prm.ro_w.zh: 只读。不写文件，也不跑命令。

gui.set.prm.sb_auto_w.zh: 有可用沙箱时自动启用
gui.set.prm.sb_auto_w.en: Uses a sandbox when one is available

gui.set.prm.sb_box_w.zh: 在轻量沙箱内运行命令
gui.set.prm.sb_box_w.en: Runs commands inside the boxlite sandbox

gui.set.prm.sb_none_w.en: Commands run directly on this machine

gui.set.prm.workspace_h.zh: 工具只能读写工作区目录
gui.set.prm.workspace_h.en: Tools may only touch the workspace directory

gui.set.pro.b1.en: pick up a thread you left unfinished
gui.set.pro.b1.zh: 接着做你上次没做完的事

gui.set.pro.b2.en: report a scheduled run that failed

gui.set.pro.b3.en: notice something worth telling you about

gui.set.pro.channels.zh: 允许主动发消息的渠道

gui.set.pro.channels_w.en: Where a proactive message would be delivered.
gui.set.pro.channels_w.zh: 主动消息从哪里发出去。

gui.set.pro.hero.zh: Raven 只在被问到时才动

gui.set.pro.hero_w.en: Turned on, it could act between your messages:
gui.set.pro.hero_w.zh: 打开后，它可以在你两次开口之间做事：

gui.set.pro.on.en: Let it act on its own

gui.set.restart_note.zh: 改动已写入配置；部分设置在重启 raven serve 后生效。
gui.set.restart_note.en: Written to the config; some of these apply after restarting raven serve.

gui.set.ro_note.en: Read-only here. These values are edited in
gui.set.ro_note.zh: 这些值只能在配置文件里改：

gui.set.store_hint.en: Sessions, attachments and exports are all here.
gui.set.store_hint.zh: 会话、附件与导出都在这里。

gui.set.sub.about.en: Version, logs and where to report things.
gui.set.sub.about.zh: 版本、日志，以及去哪里反馈。

gui.set.sub.account.en: Who this copy of Raven belongs to.

gui.set.sub.channel.en: How Raven talks to you outside this window.
gui.set.sub.channel.zh: Raven 在这个窗口之外怎么找你。

gui.set.sub.data.en: Where everything is stored, and how to get rid of it.
gui.set.sub.data.zh: 东西都存在哪，以及怎么清掉。

gui.set.sub.exec.en: Where commands run, and with what environment.
gui.set.sub.exec.zh: 命令在哪里跑，带着什么环境。

gui.set.sub.look.en: Language, theme and type. All of it takes effect immediately.
gui.set.sub.look.zh: 语言、主题和字体，全部即时生效。

gui.set.sub.memory.zh: Raven 在会话之间带走什么。

gui.set.sub.model.en: Which providers are connected, and how the model answers.
gui.set.sub.model.zh: 连接了哪些提供方，以及模型怎么作答。

gui.set.sub.notify.en: When Raven is allowed to interrupt you.
gui.set.sub.notify.zh: 什么时候允许 Raven 打断你。

gui.set.sub.perm.en: What the agent may do without asking first.
gui.set.sub.perm.zh: agent 在不问你的情况下能做什么。

gui.set.sub.proact.en: Whether Raven may start something on its own.
gui.set.sub.proact.zh: Raven 能不能主动开始做事。

gui.set.sub.toolset.en: Which built-in actions this agent may use.
gui.set.sub.toolset.zh: 这个智能体可以使用哪些内置动作。

gui.set.sub.usage.en: What this month cost, and where to stop.
gui.set.sub.usage.zh: 这个月花了多少，以及在哪里停下。

gui.set.temp_hint.en: Lower is steadier, higher is more adventurous.

gui.set.tls.entry_w.en: Skills, MCP servers and plugins live in their own module.
gui.set.tls.entry_w.zh: 技能、MCP 服务和插件在自己的模块里。

gui.set.tls.keys_w.en: A tool without its credential fails at call time rather than being hidden.
gui.set.tls.keys_w.zh: 缺凭据的工具不会被隐藏，会在调用时报错。

gui.set.tracing_hint.en: Record every step so a run can be replayed; the timeline in run details comes from this.
gui.set.tracing_hint.zh: 把每一步落成可回放的记录，「运行详情」里的时间线就是它记的。

gui.set.use.guard_w.en: Warn at the first number, refuse to start a turn past the second.
gui.set.use.guard_w.zh: 到第一个数字提醒，超过第二个就不再开始新的一轮。

gui.set.use.nodata_w.en: Spend and token totals arrive once the backend reports them.
gui.set.use.nodata_w.zh: 用量和 token 统计要等后端上报后才有。

gui.set.use.token.en: Show token usage in the UI
gui.set.use.token.zh: 界面显示 token 用量

gui.upg.body.en: {from} to {to}. The Raven service restarts and this page reloads; your sessions are kept.
gui.upg.body.zh: {from} 升到 {to}。Raven 服务会重启、页面会自动刷新，会话不会丢。

gui.upg.body_busy.en: A turn is still running. Let it finish before upgrading.
gui.upg.body_busy.zh: 当前还有回合在跑，跑完再升级。

gui.upg.gave_up.en: It has been 20 minutes with no answer from Raven.
gui.upg.gave_up.zh: 已经等了 20 分钟，Raven 仍然没有响应。

gui.upg.manual.en: Run this in a terminal instead:
gui.upg.manual.zh: 改在终端里跑这条命令：

gui.upg.reauth.en: Raven restarted but this page is no longer signed in. Reopen Raven.
gui.upg.reauth.zh: Raven 已重启，但这个页面的登录失效了，请重新打开 Raven。

gui.ws.agents_absent.en: This server does not report delegated work.
gui.ws.agents_absent.zh: 这个服务端不上报交办出去的工作。

gui.ws.file_big.zh: 太大了，没法在这里渲染。

gui.ws.file_binary.en: Nothing to render for this kind of file.
gui.ws.file_binary.zh: 这种文件没有可渲染的形式。

gui.ws.file_denied.en: Raven is confined to the workspace, so this file cannot be opened here.
gui.ws.file_denied.zh: Raven 被限制在工作目录内，这个文件没法在这里打开。

gui.ws.file_gone.en: That file is no longer there.

gui.ws.reveal_explorer.zh: 在文件资源管理器中显示

gui.ws.json_capped.en: … the rest is only in the source view
gui.ws.json_capped.zh: … 其余内容请切换到源码视图

gui.ws.search_capped.en: Workspace too large to search fully

gui.ws.search_more.en: {n} more matches hidden - narrow the search
gui.ws.search_more.zh: 还有 {n} 个匹配未显示，换个更准的词

gui.ws.sub.browser.en: Pages and searches it went through

gui.ws.sub.changes.en: Files it wrote, with line diffs
gui.ws.sub.changes.zh: 它写过的文件与行内 diff

gui.set.prm.file_only.en: Changed only in the config file, then restart raven:
gui.set.prm.file_only.zh: 只能在配置文件里修改，改完重启 raven 生效：

gui.agent.builtin_h.en: Raven's own agents. Always available, nothing to install; switch one off to keep it off the roster.
gui.agent.builtin_h.zh: Raven 自己的智能体。始终可用、无需安装；关掉某一个即可让它不出现在名单里。

gui.agent.vendored_h.en: Separate Raven builds that came with this install. Nothing to connect - each is a folder on disk, so removing one means removing its folder. One that is not built yet stays off the roster until it is.
gui.agent.vendored_h.zh: 随本次安装一起来的几个独立 Raven 构建。无需连接 —— 每一个都是磁盘上的一个目录，要移除就是删掉那个目录。没构建完的会一直不出现在名单里。

gui.agent.install_note.en: Downloads this build's dependencies (a few hundred MB) and takes a few minutes. It keeps running if you leave this page.
gui.agent.install_note.zh: 会下载这个构建的依赖(几百 MB),要几分钟。离开这个页面也会继续跑。

gui.agent.packaged_note.en: Name and description come with the package, not from config, so there is nothing to connect or save here.
gui.agent.packaged_note.zh: 名称和描述随安装包一起来,不在配置里,所以这里没有可连接或可保存的东西。
